_meta.purpose: Data-prep shortlist for a /madrichim suppressed-appetite (GLP-1-lens) dairy guide. UNORDERED — no 1-N ranking. NO scoring change, NO new scrape, NO enrichment.
_meta.ordering: none — array order is barcode-sorted for file determinism only; Frontend/Content must not treat array position as a recommendation rank
_meta.basis_confirmed: per_100ml — single disclosed basis for every product on the live page (expansion.servingNote == 'ל-100 מ״ל' for all 18; assertion enforced at build time, not assumed)

gating_ruling_applied.satiety_support: DROPPED entirely — Nutrition excluded it as a gameable, not-honestly-caveatable proxy for this use. Not present anywhere in this file.
gating_ruling_applied.nutrient_density_dimension_score: DROPPED / not relied upon for the protein bar — cross-category-calibrated, misrepresents milk. Protein bar uses RAW protein_g + energy_kcal only (see protein_density block).
gating_ruling_applied.added_sugar_basis: added_sugar_sources_count (L3, ingredient-derived), NOT sugars_g (natural lactose / unmeasured for plant milks). sugars_g retained only in the transparency panel, explicitly labeled NOT-added-sugar.

_meta.score_grade_cross_check: PASS — all 18 products' trace.final_score_estimate/grade_estimate matched frontend score/grade exactly before this dataset trusted the trace as an extension source

corpus_stats.basis: per_100ml, across all 18 products on the live milk_and_alternatives shelf (milk_frontend_v1.json)
corpus_stats.note: For Nutrition to lock the sodium 3-band cutoffs (structure already set; mg thresholds provisional) and for Content to sanity-check the protein/energy bands. Computed directly from this dataset's own per-product values above (recomputed here, not copied from elsewhere).

products.basis: per_100ml (single disclosed basis for every product on the live page — confirmed via expansion.servingNote)

protein_density.protein_g_per_100kcal_method: protein_g_per100 / energy_kcal_per100 * 100 — arithmetic only, from the two RAW disclosed values above; not the engine's nutrient_density dimension score (excluded per Nutrition ruling: that score is cross-category-calibrated and misrepresents milk)
protein_density.per_serving_method: protein_g_per100 * serving_size_g / 100 (arithmetic conversion using the already-scraped BSIP1 serving_size_g label field; not a new measurement)

added_sugar.source: BSIP2 trace L3_inferred_classifications.added_sugar_sources_count (ingredient-derived; already-parsed, not recomputed here)
added_sugar.caveat: This bar is intentionally NOT built from sugars_g. sugars_g in this corpus is overwhelmingly natural lactose for dairy products (and often unmeasured for plant milks) and is not a proxy for added sugar. added_sugar_sources_count counts distinct added-sugar ingredient markers detected in the label's ingredient text.

published_score_grade.note: Shown for benchmark placement ONLY. This dataset is UNORDERED — do not sort/rank by this field for the guide.
